record.title: Lachin corridor obstruction and tightening access restrictions
record.direction: Both directions; scope varied by phase
record.movement: Civilian movement, essential goods and humanitarian relief
record.exceptions: Intermittent ICRC aid and medical evacuations; aid passage on 18 September 2023
record.imposing_authority: Actors restricting the Lachin corridor; Azerbaijan controlled access in later phases
record.enforcement: ICJ observes disruption; ICRC provides direct evidence of blocked aid and exceptions.
record.consequences: ICJ and ICRC document medical-access problems and shortages of essential goods.
record.status_observation: Aid obstruction documented 25 July 2023; limited aid crossed 18 September; ordinary reopening unresolved
record.official_rationale: Protesters claimed environmental and mining grievances. Azerbaijan later attributed checkpoint control to alleged illicit weapons/resources movement, safety and sovereignty. These are actor-specific contested explanations, not judicial findings.
record.context: Conflict-related corridor blockage; humanitarian access was later severely restricted.
record.uncertainty: No single unrestricted reopening date established. September aid deliveries and later mass departure do not establish normal bilateral travel. Initial actor attribution is not settled in the reviewed sources.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
